# sreagent_team (Resource)

A team. Its members are sreagent_team_member resources or are managed in the app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sreagent_team" "platform" {
  name = "platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique within the organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `members` (String) Current members.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax, or with an `import` block
naming the same ID. See the [importing guide](../guides/importing.md).

```shell
# Collections import by id.
terraform import sreagent_team.platform 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
